related_questions.question: Does Medicare cover immunotherapy for kidney cancer?
related_questions.snippet: Yes, Medicare provides coverage for immunotherapy. It falls under medically necessary cancer treatment supplies, services, and prescription drugs. The way your immunotherapy is administered determines which part of Medicare — Part A (hospital), B (medical), or D (prescription drugs) — will cover the treatment.
